To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel approach to temporal pattern recognition using dynamic time warping as a basis to learn feature maps for a neural network, and that this method can achieve comparable accuracies to state of the-art methods.
the proposed DTW Neural Network (DTWNN) can be used for efficient classification of on-line handwritten digits.
the proposed DTW Neural Networks (NN) can learn to classify temporal patterns directly and can be trained using standard back propagation techniques.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following: (1) How to use the DTW kernel as the basis of a neural network.
developing a robust and accurate method for temporal pattern recognition.
developing a neural network for the recognition of temporal patterns, such as handwritten characters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is robust, efficient, and accurate for temporal pattern recognition.
the proposed approach is able to achieve a classification accuracy of 97.6% for isolated on-line handwritten digits, which is competitive with other state of the art results.
this paper proposes a method that can classify isolated temporal patterns using dynamic time warping as the basis for a kernel like function.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method can be used to learn temporal patterns with high efficiency.
a neural network can be trained to learn the dissimilarity function of a temporal pattern.
the proposed DTW based NN can be used for classification of temporal patterns.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed method is a general purpose neural network architecture that is able to classify temporal data directly.
a simple neural network with a dissimilarity based kernel function can be used for classification of temporal patterns.
the proposed method can learn temporal features from raw data without any pre-processing or feature extraction.
